_about: Weather and light on the islands by round (core/weather_rules.gd decides, game/island_weather.gd shows it). A round gets the LAST stage whose from_round it has reached. density = fog added per metre (0.01 hides about 40 % of a thing 50 m away); density_per_round is added for every round past from_round, up to density_max. fog_color = the fog and the cover over the sky. sky_tint multiplies the photo sky (and with it the light in the shade). sky_cover 0..1 = how much of the sky the fog colour hides. sun = share of the sun's brightness left, sun_color multiplies its colour. rain 0..1 = share of the graphics tier's drops. bed = the looping sound (data/sounds.json ambience). boss: laid over the stage while a boss round is being fought (its colours replace the stage's, its sun multiplies, density_add is added). lightning: only in a stage with rain; a flash every flash_every [shortest, longest] seconds, `flashes` flickers of flash_seconds each at `sun` times the normal sun, thunder thunder_after [shortest, longest] seconds later. rain: drops per graphics tier (0 = no rain drawn), box = metres round the camera the drops live in, fall = metres a second (x, y, z), streak and width in metres, near_cut = drops nearer than this are hidden (near_cut_indoors while standing in a hut, so none fall through the roof). blend_seconds = how long one weather takes to become the next; leave_seconds = how fast it clears when you leave the islands by air.
